info.title: Pictory API
info.description:
The Pictory API enables programmatic creation, preview, and rendering of AI-generated videos. This specification covers the most-used endpoints for the storyboard, render, project, jobs, and branding workflows.

Authentication uses a direct API key (no Bearer prefix). Obtain a key from the Pictory App at https://app.pictory.ai/api-access — keys start with the prefix `pictai_`.

post.description:
Generates a preview of your video project so you can review storyboard structure, scene breakdown, and visual selections before committing to the final render.
Returns a `jobId` which should be polled against the Get Storyboard Preview Job endpoint.
Use this when you want to validate content before incurring full rendering cost.

scenes.story: AI is transforming how we create content. It automates tasks and saves time.

post.description:
Renders the final video file directly from a storyboard configuration, skipping the preview step.
Accepts the same request body as Create Storyboard Preview.
Returns a `jobId` that can be polled at the Get Video Render Job endpoint.

scenes.story: Welcome to our product showcase. Discover amazing features.

post.description:
Initiates rendering for an existing Pictory project. Projects can be created via the Pictory App or saved via the Create Storyboard Preview API with `saveProject: true`.
Returns a `jobId` that can be polled at the Get Video Render Job endpoint.

parameters.name: projectid
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the project to render. Obtain from the Get Projects API.

get.summary: Get Video Render Job by ID
get.description:
Retrieves the status and results of a video render job by its UUID.
While a job is processing, the response contains progress information. Once completed, it returns all output URLs (video, audio, thumbnail, subtitle files).
Poll this endpoint every 10-30 seconds, or use the `webhook` field on the render request for push notifications.

parameters.name: jobid
parameters.description: The unique UUID of the render job, returned by any render endpoint.

200.description: Job status retrieved. Inspect `data.status` for `in-progress`, `completed`, or `failed`. Note that `success: false` with `status: failed` is also returned with HTTP 200.

data.error_message: The AI voice speaker [Timm] is invalid and is not supported. Please provide valid AI voice speaker.

get.description:
Returns the list of video brand configurations defined in the user's Pictory account.
Each brand is identified by a UUID `id` (use this when applying a brand to a render) and a human-readable `name`.

ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: Pictory API key. Pass the raw key value (which starts with `pictai_`) directly as the `Authorization` header value. Do NOT prefix with `Bearer`. Example: `Authorization: pictai_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`. Obtain a key from https://app.pictory.ai/api-access.

success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful

jobId.description: Unique identifier for the created job. Use this with the Get Video Render Job by ID endpoint.

id.description: Unique identifier for the video brand

name.description: Descriptive name of the video brand

JobStatusResponse.description: Unified response shape for the Get Video Render Job by ID endpoint. The fields present in `data` vary by job status.

id.description: Alternate identifier present in the JOB_NOT_FOUND error response

renderProgress.description: Render progress percentage (0-100). Present once rendering has started.

videoURL.description: Direct download URL for the rendered MP4 video

audioURL.description: Direct download URL for the MP3 audio track

encodingDuration.description: Time taken to encode and render the video in seconds

aiCreditsUsed.description: Total AI credits consumed for AI visual generation. Present only when the video includes scenes with `aiVisual`.

youtubeClearanceCode.description: YouTube Content ID clearance code for the background music. Present only when the video uses a Melodie library track. Enter it in YouTube Studio to clear the Content ID claim on this video; valid until `youtubeClearanceExpiresAt`.

youtubeClearanceExpiresAt.description: `youtubeClearanceCode` is valid until this time. After that it no longer works, and the next call returns a new code with a new expiry.

StoryboardRequest.description: Top-level storyboard request body shared by Create Storyboard Preview and Render Storyboard Video. `scenes` is required unless `templateId` is supplied. `brandId` and `brandName` are mutually exclusive (provide at most one). The same exclusivity applies to `smartLayoutId`/`smartLayoutName` and `subtitleStyleId`/`subtitleStyleName`. Set `aiStoryboard.enabled` to true to have the AI design every scene (text-to-video sources only).

videoName.description: Name for the video project. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, spaces, underscores, hyphens. Optional when `aiStoryboard` is enabled with a `brief` scene: if omitted, the AI-generated title is used.

videoWidth.description: Video width in pixels. Must be supplied together with `videoHeight`.

videoHeight.description: Video height in pixels. Must be supplied together with `videoWidth`.

saveProject.description: Whether to save the project for later editing.

webhook.description: URL to POST the job result to when finished.

webhookInput.description: Custom data echoed back in the webhook payload.

templateId.description: Template ID. Obtain from Get Templates API.

variables.description: Key/value pairs for template variables. Only valid with `templateId`.

brandId.description: Brand ID to apply. Mutually exclusive with `brandName`.

brandName.description: Brand name to apply. Mutually exclusive with `brandId`.

smartLayoutId.description: Smart layout ID. Mutually exclusive with `smartLayoutName`.

smartLayoutName.description: Smart layout name. Mutually exclusive with `smartLayoutId`.

storyboardVersion.description: Experimental. Set to `v3` to use the latest Pictory storyboard. Omit for classic storyboard.

subtitleStyleId.description: Saved text style ID for subtitles. Mutually exclusive with `subtitleStyleName`.

subtitleStyleName.description: Saved text style name for subtitles. Mutually exclusive with `subtitleStyleId`.

awsConnectionId.description: AWS connection ID for private S3 assets.

vimeoConnectionId.description: Vimeo connection ID for direct Vimeo uploads.

destinations.description: Destinations to upload the generated video to.

scenes.description: Array of scenes. Required unless `templateId` is supplied.

payloadUrl.description: Optional URL to fetch a payload (backend-supported field).

projectMetadata.description: Arbitrary metadata stored with the saved project.

speaker.description: Voice speaker name (e.g. 'Brian', 'Emma'). Obtain available voices from the Get Voiceover Tracks API.

syncVoice.description: Auto-sync the external voice with video subtitles.

BackgroundMusic.description: Background music configuration. `autoMusic` and `musicUrl` are mutually exclusive.

musicUrl.description: Any publicly accessible URL to an audio file, not only a Pictory-provided track. An `audioUrl` from Search Music Tracks is also valid, passed exactly as returned. Cannot be used with `autoMusic`.

width.description: Logo width as a percentage e.g. '15%'.

Avatar.description: Avatar configuration for presenter-style videos. Avatars require voice-over to be enabled.

avatarId.description: Account-scoped avatar identifier. MUST be discovered at runtime via `GET /v1/avatars` — do not hard-code values. Available avatars vary per account.

hide.description: Hide the avatar globally. Can be overridden per scene.

SubtitleStyle.description: Inline subtitle style. Can be applied at the video level or per scene.

fontFamily.description: Font family name. Required when `fontUrl` is provided.

animations.description: Max 2 animations: one entry, one exit.

futureWords.description: Only available with `fade` and `blur` entry animations.

Destination.description: Destination configuration. Currently `vimeo` and `s3` types are supported.

Scene.description: Each scene must contain exactly one content source: `story`, `brief`, `blogUrl`, `pptUrl`, `audioUrl`, or `videoUrl`.

story.description: Plain text content for the scene.

maxSubtitleLines.description: Caption lines shown simultaneously. Cannot be used with smart layouts.

endPauseDuration.description: Pause at end of scene in seconds.

pptSlideAnimation.description: Animate PowerPoint slides into short video backgrounds. Each still slide is sent to an image-to-video model using the slide itself as the first frame, so the clip opens on the original slide. The clip loops for the length of the scene, so the slide returns at the start of every cycle. Slides that already contain video or PowerPoint build animations are left unchanged. Only valid with `pptUrl`.

enabled.description: Set to true to animate slides.

model.description: Video model used to animate the slides. Defaults to pixverse6 when omitted, which does not consume AI credits. The veo3.1 and veo3.1_fast models consume AI credits and reproduce small slide text more reliably. Clips are capped at 10 seconds.

slides.description: Slide positions to animate, starting at 1. Omit or pass an empty array to animate every eligible slide.

isSSMLStory.description: Story contains SSML markup. Only valid with `story`.

backgroundMusic.description: Gives one scene its own music, sets how loud it is, or turns music off for that scene. All the scene music is joined into one soundtrack.

enabled.description: Set to `false` for no music in this scene. Required when `musicUrl` is not set. It is `true` when `musicUrl` is set.

musicUrl.description: The music for this scene: a public link to an audio file, or an `audioUrl` from Search Music Tracks copied exactly as returned.

volume.description: How loud this scene's music is, from 0 to 1. Use it only with `musicUrl`. If left out, the scene uses the video's music volume.

transcript.description: Transcript of input video/audio. Required for `audioUrl`/`videoUrl`.

elements.description: Overlay elements (shapes, text, videos, images) placed on top of the scene background.

Brief.description: Describe the video and the AI writes the script. With `aiStoryboard` enabled, the AI also decides the scenes and designs each of them; the `brief` must then be the only scene, `prompt` is limited to 3900 characters, `duration` to 8–500 seconds, and the scene split options are not allowed.

prompt.description: Topic or description for AI to generate content. At most 3900 characters with `aiStoryboard`.

duration.description: Target duration in seconds. 8–500 with `aiStoryboard`; omit to let the AI choose.

platform.description: Target platform for script generation. Not used by the AI Storyboard.

AiStoryboard.description: AI Storyboard. When `enabled` is true, every scene receives a layout, on-screen text elements, and a color palette chosen by AI: with `story`/`blogUrl` scenes the AI designs around your narration (script mode); with a single `brief` scene it writes the script and designs the storyboard (brief mode). Text-to-video only: `templateId`, `variables`, `smartLayoutId`, `smartLayoutName`, `aspectRatio` `4:5`, and the scene fields `pptUrl`, `audioUrl`, `videoUrl`, `transcript`, `mediaRepurposeSettings`, `audioLanguage`, `useSpeakerNotes`, `isSSMLStory`, `backgroundBrolls`, `backgroundCorpus`, `templateOverride` are rejected. Story scenes without a split option are split one scene per sentence; a scene that cannot be split and exceeds 1500 characters is rejected; at most 250 designed scenes.

enabled.description: Set to true to have the AI design the storyboard.

SceneAvatarOverride.description: Scene-level avatar override. `avatarId` cannot be changed at the scene level.

top.description: Distance from top as integer percentage. Cannot be used with `position`.

left.description: Distance from left as integer percentage. Cannot be used with `position`.

Background.description: Scene background. Must contain exactly one of `visualUrl`, `color`, or `aiVisual`.

color.description: Solid background color in RGBA, or hex format.

model.description: AI model. Image models: flux-schnell, seedream3.0, nanobanana, nanobanana-pro. Video models: pixverse5.5, veo3.1_fast, veo3.1.

videoDuration.description: Video clip duration; valid values depend on model. pixverse5.5: 5s/8s/10s; veo3.1*: 4s/6s/8s.

visualContinuity.description: Enable visual continuity between consecutive AI-generated scenes.

firstFrameImageUrl.description: Video type only. Mutually exclusive with `referenceImageUrls`.

referenceImageUrls.description: Video type only. Mutually exclusive with `firstFrameImageUrl`.

ColorOverlay.description: Semi-transparent color tint rendered on top of the background or media element. Transparency is controlled only by `opacity`; an RGBA color's alpha channel is ignored.

color.description: Tint color in RGB, RGBA, or hex format.

SceneElement.description: Overlay element placed on top of the scene background. `shape` and `text` are decorative overlays; `video` and `image` are media overlays sourced from exactly one of `visualUrl`, `searchFilter`, or `aiVisual`. Use `position` or `top`/`left`, not both.

name.description: Shape only (required): shape name, e.g. rectangle, circle, badge-3.

strokeWidth.description: Shape only: outline thickness in pixels.

text.description: Text only (required): the text to display.

textVariant.description: Text only: decorative preset. Defaults to body.

visualUrl.description: Media only: URL of the video or image file to overlay.

searchFilter.description: Media only: stock library search. If no match is found, the element is skipped.

query.description: What to search for, in plain language.

aiVisual.description: Media only: generate the element with AI. Consumes AI Credits according to the selected model's rate.

colorOverlay.description: Media only: color tint applied to this element.

top.description: Vertical offset percentage, e.g. "10%". Mutually exclusive with `position`.

left.description: Horizontal offset percentage, e.g. "10%". Mutually exclusive with `position`.

width.description: Element width as a percentage of the canvas, e.g. "30%". Media elements without a width are sized automatically to stay fully on screen.

TemplateOverride.description: Configuration for manipulating template scenes. Only available when `templateId` is provided.

tags.name: Videos
tags.description: Storyboard preview, render, and project rendering endpoints
